critical_interpretation: The 25-example collection cap is not proof 25 images are sufficient, and validation is same-source GBIF observations. No independent indoor smartphone benchmark exists. A 100% accuracy claim cannot be supported.
next_evidence_gates: For each species, independently verify taxon labels and image rights; retain source attribution.
Collect additional diverse indoor potted smartphone images, including hard lookalike species and unknown plants, without reusing the same individual plant in train and test.
Group splits by plant individual, photographer and source site; review perceptual duplicates and repeated settings.
Train only on approved images; report top-1/top-3 and per-species confusion on an independent phone-photo test set; evaluate abstention rather than treating a softmax score as correctness.
Keep currently bundled 101-class model explicitly experimental until evidence meets release gates.
actions_taken: Investigation only; no model weights or reported accuracy modified.
